name: Bamburi Cement Plc
source: Bamburi Cement Plc audited consolidated statement of cash flows, Annual Report and Financial Statements 2025, printed page 72 (Kes millions). Figures stored in absolute KES. Capital Expenditure is the sum of purchase of property, plant and equipment and purchase of intangible assets as printed. Free Cash Flow is Operating Cash Flow plus Capital Expenditure, using the operating cash flow this file already holds: FY2024's stored operating figure includes interest received of KES 310m, so its Free Cash Flow is on that same basis.
